stage: exposed development diagnostic, frozen before balanced molecular runs
functional: same F/Q density-functional pair closure, no new electronic parameters
orbital_objective: equal average of lowest two spin-singlet CAS(2,2) eigenvalues
gap: difference of lowest two eigenvalues at their common optimized orbitals
initial_orbitals: retained ground occupied/virtual spaces rotated toward retained OO transition
acceptance: orbital residual < 1e-7, target root open-singlet weight > 0.5, projected transition character >= 0.7
